test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rani has borrowed an amount of ₹2,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest will she pay at a rate of 7% per annum after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,00,000

Rate (R) = 7% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = dfrac{2,00,000 times 2 times 7}{100}

⇒ SI = 28,000

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
